game_concept: A strategy race set in Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge, the basecamp on a ridge: the mountaineer must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Cipher Decoder: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes.
theme: Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge: the basecamp on a ridge
core_gameplay_loop: In Basecamp Ridge, repeat each round: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the mountaineer ahead. Then check the decoded value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ice ladder by solving code steps involving decoded that move the mountaineer forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ice ladder first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Cipher Decoder
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Cipher Decoder' (Week 8 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Basecamp Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how decoded changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Basecamp Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
